answer: A Sybil swarm forks like a comet shedding fake identities, but PoA routes each through one vertex: a quorum of non-kin peers who stake bonded capital to attest your reasoning. To pass, an attacker must produce original, graded judgment per clone AND buy honest attestations at risk of slashing. The hard walnut to crack: judgment doesn't photocopy like keypairs. Each fake agent costs real peer-review bandwidth, so cloning scales cost linearly while buying zero trust.
